protocol.interpretation: Uniform post-hoc sensitivity analysis, specified before revised outcomes; never replaces raw or v1 decisions.
protocol.method: Amber14/GBn2, 12 A cutoff, both backbones restrained; all side chains and hydrogens mobile
protocol.protonation: Strip explicit H; PROPKA assigns H consistently to free and bound forms of the same prepared conformation. Any incomplete/protonation-failed group invalidates that calculation.
protocol.cohort: All confidence-selected reserve confirmation bare/tagged models, including failures and controls.
protocol.movement_scope: Target and binder-core backbone guards; full-tag movement also reported. The suffix is restrained during preparation but cannot disqualify the core solely by its flexible backbone displacement.
protocol.policy: One preparation per source; no selective retries; source sequence and original atom identities preserved; raw screen failures cannot be rescued. Original pose/contact/context gates and pKa heuristics unchanged.
limitations: No unbound ensemble or full proton linkage
Finite minimization is not proof of convergence or global stereochemical validity
